test_case.purpose: For each approved socket/CCM, inject one authoritative watchdog fault, verify a fresh SyncFlood reset and CCM-specific durable record, and restore memory, xGMI/inter-socket coherence and platform state.
required_package: CCM-specific CPER/MCA source and reset/boot timing
OOB boot/reimage, memory/xGMI recovery and exact rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not inject or clear reset status. After approval, preserve forensic pre-state, capture raw settings and coherency health, perform one mapped CCM stimulus once under OOB capture, correlate fresh SyncFlood and CCM CPER through reboot, then restore and validate memory/xGMI/inter-socket health.
test_case.expected_result: The intended CCM source follows the signed reset branch, produces a fresh CCM-specific durable record and reset-cause transition, boots within deadline, has no persistent MCA/memory/xGMI error and returns all controls to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until flag/register/reset semantics are authoritative. Generic watchdog/BERT, SyncFlood=1 alone, wrong source, stale record, missing/unexpected reset, boot failure, coherency error or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent OOB and reimage path.
Preserve status/BERT evidence before any approved clear.
One socket/CCM once; abort on wrong source, boot loop, memory/xGMI error or persistent SyncFlood.
expected_evidence: Raw threshold/reset status and coherency baseline
Single injection and OOB reset/boot timeline
Fresh CCM-specific CPER/MCA and SyncFlood transition
test_case.recovery: Cover unexpected/missing reset, boot-loop/reimage, memory/xGMI faults and forensic-safe reset-status cleanup while restoring threshold, Platform First, FCH and HDT. Execution remains blocked until approved.
